verdict.rationale: The docs say CodeRabbit reviews catch security vulnerabilities alongside functional bugs such as race conditions, memory leaks, null pointers and logic flaws, and that it supports linters and SAST tools. A hands-on community report describes a PR review that flagged a critical security risk. Exposed-secrets detection is documented only in the separately metered AI Deep Scan, and security checks can also be steered with path instructions. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of injection-risk and insecure-pattern detection within diff reviews, leaked-secret detection in standard PR review rather than the separate Deep Scan, and independent accuracy corroboration for security findings.
